RNG Miner RNG Miner is a Pickaxe enchantment that can go up to tier 3 (iii). igndante
Message Edited in #slots-gambling Jump to Message
Before
The Slot Machine is a feature in GeneratorCraft that allows you to gamble using Slot Tokens. The three slots in the GUI will roll a random item, if all three slots match the same item, the item is dropped as a reward. The loot has a forgiving system. Every spin adds 1 to the forgive counter. When the forgive counter surpasses 75 the table used to define the 3 items becomes much more empty and fair. When the counter reaches 200 it resets. The unforgiving table can have any GeneratorCraft item. The forgiving tables make all 3 slots include only:
  • Lootbox related items
after
The Slot Machine is a feature in GeneratorCraft that allows you to gamble using Slot Tokens. The three slots in the GUI will roll a random item, if all three slots match the same item, the item is dropped as a reward. The loot has a forgiving system. Every spin adds 1 to the forgive counter. When the forgive counter surpasses 75 the table used to define the 3 items becomes much more empty and fair. When the counter reaches 200 it resets. The unforgiving table can have any GeneratorCraft item. The forgiving tables make all 3 slots include only:
  • Lootbox related items
  • Weapon related items
  • Generator related items
  • Generator Upgrades related items
  • Currency related items

  • Coin drop chance upgrade
  • Box drop chance upgrade [TOGGLE] (toggles whether you want to drop boxes or not)
  • Coin multiplier upgrade
  • Gem drop chance upgrade
  • Combat Log time upgrade
  • Price Multiplier upgrade
    • Adblock (remove advertisements #advertisements )
  • Remove Watermark ( #watermark )
  • Gem Shop
  • Slot Machine ( #slots-gambling )
  • Banking ( #banking )

igndante
Message Edited in #gemstone-obelisk Jump to Message
Before
Gemstone Obelisk The Gemstone Obelisk is a flex trophy block that can be bought from the Gem Shop ( #gem-shop ) After placing it down, right-clicking it will set an owner to it. Right-Clicking an obelisk that already has an owner will show in chat who own's it. Breaking an obelisk that doesn't belong to you will return it to it's owner. While holding an obelisk, could be converted back to Gems using /convertobelisk ( #convertobelisk )
after
Gemstone Obelisk The Gemstone Obelisk is a flex trophy block that can be bought from the Gem Shop ( #gem-shop ) As of GeneratorCraft 1.2.4, the Obelisk's price does not get reduced by the Price Multiplier After placing it down, right-clicking it will set an owner to it. Right-Clicking an obelisk that already has an owner will show in chat who own's it. Breaking an obelisk that doesn't belong to you will return it to it's owner. While holding an obelisk, could be converted back to Gems using /convertobelisk ( #convertobelisk )

Message Edited in #worldbank-economy Jump to Message
Before
The World Bank The World Bank is a feature added in the 1.2.6 update of GeneratorCraft.
  • Every world has a default world bank amount of 1,000,000
  • The World Bank only deals in Coins The state of the World Bank's currency affect the Economy Boost and the Economy State:
  • <-500,000 = Economy Boost: 0.1x, Economy State: Collapsed
  • <0 = Economy Boost: 0.25x, Economy State: Debt Crisis
  • <200,000 = Economy Boost: 0.5x, Economy State: Depression
  • <500,000 = Economy Boost: 0.75x, Economy State: Recession
  • <1,000,000 = Economy Boost: 1x, Economy State: Stable
  • <2,000,000 = Economy Boost: 1.25x, Economy State: Booming
  • <5,000,000 = Economy Boost: 1.5x, Economy State: Overheated
  • <10,000,000 = Economy Boost: 2x, Economy State: Inflated
  • >9,999,999 = Economy Boost: 3x, Economy State: Hyperinflation If the Economy Boost stat is above 1x, it will only affect the prices of things (ex. upgrades, shop items)
If the Economy Boost is below 1x, it will only affect the output of things ...

  • *(N...

Before
After killing a mob, Coins, Gems and Lootboxes may drop according to the player's respective chances The formulas are as such: Coin Drop amount from non monster entities = ((MaxHP/2)+Random[1-10])*CoinMultiplier Coin Drop amount from monster entities = (((MaxHP/2)+Random[1-10)+(MaxHP/2))*CoinMultiplier Gem Drop amount from non monster entities = ((MaxHP/5)+Random[1-5])*GemMultiplier Gem Drop amount from monster entities = (((MaxHP/5)+Random[1-10)+(MaxHP/5))*GemMultiplier If the Looting enchantment is present this amount is added(+) at the end of the formula: Coins = CoinDrop*((1.5*LootingLevel)+(Random[1-10]) Gems = GemDrop*((1*LootingLevel)+(Random[1-10]) Lootbox Drop: Lootboxes will drop according to your Box Chance. If the weapon has Looting there exists a formula to drop another Lootbox: if Random[LootingLevel-10] is bigger than 5
after
